messages:
alex.k: Hey team, hitting a weird one with a customer's service account key — embeddings and rerank failing with 403 while chat-gen works. Request: POST /v1/embeddings -> 403. Details below.

maria.s: Can you paste the token header or the raw claims? quick check: is it a scoped key or org key?

alex.k: Pasted minimal repro in case useful:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer SVC_abc123" \
  -d '{"model":"text-embed-001","input":"hello"}'
```
403 response: {"error":"insufficient_entitlements","message":"missing:embeddings"}

samir: Huh. Weird that chat-gen is allowed. That suggests the token has generate:on or chat scope but not embeddings/rerank. Could be the provisioning CSV truncated the last column.

alex.k: Customer says key was created by their provisioning script that hits our /internal/provision endpoint. Logs attached (redacted) — shows token claim "entitlements":"generate,rerank" — so the rerank claim is present but embeddings missing.

maria.s: If the claim string is free-form, comma delim behavior varies between systems. Did they include a trailing space or odd delimiter? Our parser normalizes on commas only.

alex.k: I reproduced locally: provisioning with `entitlements=generate, rerank` (note space) produces JWT claim exactly like that. Our parser splits on "," and trims; should have handled it but maybe the CSV was double-quoted and inserted a non-breaking space (U+00A0).

samir: Great catch. Non-breaking spaces don't trim with standard .trim() in some libs. Can you grep the provisioning logs for "\\u00A0" or run `xxd` on the CSV?

alex.k: Did `xxd -p provisioning.csv | grep f0a0` — found instances. Ugh.

maria.s: Workaround for customer: create a new key via Console (UI normalizes whitespace). Or have them re-run provisioner after normalizing spaces. Longer term, we should update provisioner to unicode-normalize and replace NBSPs.

alex.k: For immediate support note: added temporary rule in auth-gateway to treat any Unicode space as delimiter. Pushed patch to staging.

infra-bot: Deploy queued: auth-gateway patch #2345 -> staging

samir: Also check our entitlement-to-features map: embeddings requires "embeddings" entitlement; rerank requires "rerank". If a claim contains weird characters the map lookup fails.

maria.s: Escalating to eng-runtime to consider sanitizing claims at the edge. @eng-runtime please weigh in when available.

support-bot: Case #CS-4982 updated — workaround suggested (create new key via Console) and engineering escalation opened.

alex.k: Customer confirmed console-based key fixed the issue. Marking as resolved pending eng fix. :white_check_mark:

maria.s: Nice. I'll add a short KB article about provisioning CSV pitfalls and NBSPs.

samir: Add unit test for non-breaking space handling to prevent regressions.

alex.k: Thanks all. Closing thread.
